label: D2 arrival at S1 after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and essentially only when the reached state shown is S1 (99.9% of mass; D2&S1 alone gives recall 0.999 but precision 0.06). Within that, ~90% of mass comes when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0), and activity decays strongly with trial index in the episode (rate 6x lift in trials 0-9, ~0 after trial 70), so the predicate adds ep_trial<20 (dev P 0.55 R 0.55 F1 0.55, mass recall 0.63). Magnitude is larger after runs of unrewarded trials and earlier in the episode; top examples are repeated a1->S1 unrewarded trials. Never fires at D1 or GO, on S2 arrivals, or when the reward input is 1. Restricting to low model value (<8.1) raises precision to 0.83 but lowers recall; the early-episode dependence suggests it tracks a slowly varying hidden-state quantity (e.g. uncertainty about S1 value) that the predicate only approximates. All variables are observed at D2.
